verses.serigne-babacar-sy-sara-tayfuman-c1-v1: sarā ṭayfu man yā ʾakhī qad hawā bihi l-qalbu fīhi l-gharāmu nṭawā
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-sara-tayfuman-c1-v2: faʾinna l-fuʾāda lafī lawʿati wayuzʿijuhu shawquhu wal-jawā
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-sara-tayfuman-c1-v3: fadāʾī qadi shtadda ʿan ṭibbihi famā lī mudāwi dawāʾī ḥawā
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-sara-tayfuman-c1-v4: faʾayna l-mafarru ʾidhā lam ʾajid faʾayna l-maqarru lladhī qad thawā
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-sara-tayfuman-c1-v5: faʾinniyā mashghūfu qalbi ḍanā litidhkāri ṭayfi janānī ktawā
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-sara-tayfuman-c1-v6: faʾayna sh-shafīʿu l-ʾasārā ʿalā sabīli l-widādi wawiʿri nawā
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-sara-tayfuman-c1-v7: faʾayna l-karīmu lladhī yushtakā biʿʿilāti marʾi ʾilayhi ʾawā
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-sara-tayfuman-c1-v8: faʾin kāna dahrī yuḍannu bidhā ʾamīlu libahwi ṣafiyyi rawā
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-sara-tayfuman-c1-v9: fanaylu l-ʾamānī wajawfu l-farā ladayhi likulli mriʾi mā nawā
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-sara-tayfuman-c1-v10: fakam jāhili mujhili qad hadā bihi ṣāra murshida man qad ghawā
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-sara-tayfuman-c1-v11: fakam ṭālibi min wiṣāli ʾilā janābi l-malīki shadīdi l-quwā
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-sara-tayfuman-c1-v12: ʾatāhu yaḥūzu l-munā wal-hanā lahu fī ttibāʿi l-hudā mā hawā
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-sara-tayfuman-c1-v13: kafāka biʿirfāni tamyīzihi mulaqātu qawli kafāka d-dawā
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-sara-tayfuman-c1-v14: badā ʿilmuhu walawā mā daḥā bihi l-jahlu fī ʾarḍihi man tawā
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-sara-tayfuman-c1-v15: faʾaʿṭāhu rabbī rtifāʿa l-maqā mi raddī binukri l-ʿidā wit-tawā
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-sara-tayfuman-c1-v16: famin ʾayna tadrī bimithli lahu ḥabāhu l-ʾilahu dhū l-ʿarshi stawā
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-sara-tayfuman-c1-v17: fasharrafa rabbu l-barā l-ʿalī binaʿti limanʿūtihi wāḥtawā
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-sara-tayfuman-c1-v18: wafāʿilu mā shāʾa yafʿalu mā yashāʾu limafʿūlihi wathawā
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-sara-tayfuman-c1-v19: qadi htazza dīnu binayli l-munā fārfaʿu ʿanhu lliwā waquwā
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-sara-tayfuman-c1-v20: kamālu s-surūri lahu wal-jamā lu wal-ʿizzu kulu ʾilayhi ʾawā
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-sara-tayfuman-c1-v21: fanāhīka ʾin jiʾitahu yā ʾakhī ḥimāhu l-fasīḥu ʿadāka n-nawā
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-sara-tayfuman-c1-v22: ṣalatu salamu ʿalā man samā sarā laylahu wis-samā qad ṭawā
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-sara-tayfuman-c1-v23: waṣuḥbin jamīʿā kadhā tawābiʿu kulli biṣidqi rawā
